entries.zh: 用車搬運貨物；以車裝載運輸。
entries.en: to carry or haul (goods) in a cart; to transport by cart.

entries.zh: 傳話；替人傳遞口信。
entries.en: to carry a message from another person; to relay word.

entries.zh: 替人帶轉（物件）；託寄轉交。
entries.en: to carry or convey (something) on another's behalf; to send through a person entrusted.
entries.notes: 西语「afa」费解（疑为「a fe de otro」之讹），释义据「寄」与「de otro」推定。

entries.zh: 抱（小兒）；以手臂抱持小兒。
entries.en: to carry a child in one's arms; to hold a child.
entries.notes: 西语末词「animo」疑为「niño」之讹；「de la mano」与汉读「抱」只部分相合。

entries.zh: 抱在懷裡；張臂抱持。
entries.en: to carry in one's arms; to hold in an embrace.

entries.zh: 兩人共抬一物；扛抬（重貨）。
entries.en: to carry (a load) between two persons; to shoulder a load jointly.

entries.zh: 兩人抬舉（貨物）；共抬。
entries.en: to lift and carry (a load) between two; to raise and carry.
entries.notes: 汉栏原作「摕」并注[疑:擡]，据西语与音读取「擡（抬）」义。

entries.zh: 用扁擔挑運，一桿兩頭各繫一擔。
entries.en: to carry two loads slung from a single shoulder pole; to tote with a carrying pole.

entries.zh: 單肩扛負一擔；一人在一肩上荷載。
entries.en: to carry a single load on one shoulder.
entries.notes: 西语「vn nombre」当为「vn hombro」（一肩）；汉字「掎」疑为「掮」之讹。

entries.zh: （牲口）馱載貨物；裝載。
entries.en: to load and carry cargo (as a pack animal does); to lade.
entries.notes: 西语「el machio, obertia」疑为「el macho, o bestia」（公畜或牲口）。

entries.zh: 牽手引導；攜手挽引。
entries.en: to lead by the hand; to take and lead along.

entries.zh: 佩掛於身（背在背上）；背著攜行。
entries.en: to wear or carry (something) slung on the body or back.
entries.notes: M 栏尾段有 T99 污损且音读零散，「cargado a las espaldas」与「佩」义不完全相合，姑存疑。

entries.zh: 背負；以背馱負重物。
entries.en: to carry on the back; to bear a burden on one's back.

entries.zh: 騎馬；乘馬而行（馭馬）。
entries.en: to ride (a horse); to go mounted.

entries.zh: 攜取；拿走、帶走（物件）。
entries.en: to carry off, or take (something).
entries.notes: 汉栏三字连书「搆攜摧」，取「攜」义；M「hey」与 R「hū」对音不合，存疑。

entries.zh: 把貨物放上肩；肩上擔荷。
entries.en: to put the load up on the shoulder; to shoulder a load.
entries.notes: 汉栏「肓」原注[疑:肓/肩]，据音读 gueyg 与西语定为「肩」。

entries.zh: 把貨物放在背脊上；背在背上。
entries.en: to place a load on the back; to carry on one's back.
entries.notes: M 栏末三词误入西语（en las espaldas），汉读只取「放背脊」。

entries.zh: 以布帕包裹攜帶；包好帶走。
entries.en: to carry (something) wrapped in a cloth.
entries.notes: 汉栏原作「怕」并注[疑:怕/帕]，据西语「enpaño」取「帕」。

entries.zh: 把價錢抬到極點；索價過高。
entries.en: to push the price to its limit; to charge an exorbitant price.

entries.zh: 押解、運送軍糧（糧餉）；解糧。
entries.en: to convoy or transport grain provisions for troops; to deliver army grain.

entries.zh: 押解犯人上呈長官；解送人犯。
entries.en: to escort a prisoner before a superior.
entries.notes: 汉栏「紀」与音读 huan（犯）不合，应为「解犯人」。

entries.zh: 呈送判決文書予上級核閱批准；解批。
entries.en: to deliver a written sentence to a superior for review and approval.
